title: Elitewheels Drive G36 Review: Ultimate Gravel / Road Carbon Wheels vs Marvel G36 (1365g Beast!)

takeaways.text: Warranty is three years from delivery when bought from Elitewheels' website or authorized dealers.

36 mm-deep rims, 31 mm external and 25 mm internal, for 30–50 mm tires; a reduced-hook profile, Sapim CX-Ray spokes and a new angled-ratchet hub; the reviewer has discount codes and Elitewheels sponsors GCN.
With tape and valves fitted the rear wheel (HG freehub) weighed 736 g and the front 628 g, 1,365 g in total, about 100 g less than the reviewer's Marvel G36.

disclosure: The description offers a 15% Elitewheels discount code and affiliate links; it does not say how the wheels were obtained.
summary: Unboxing and quick technical check of the 2025 Drive G36: rim design, tubeless setup, the new rear hub and weight, with a comparison to the cheaper Marvel G36.
